title: RAG Lightbook stepper and snippet-generator workshop + CLI
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: reduce first-run friction for engineers learning to build RAG-driven agents by shipping a compact 'Lightbook' stepper tutorial plus a small CLI that extracts runnable API snippets from docs. This PR bundles tutorial prose, a step-by-step authoring flow with example tool contracts, an examples folder with two minimal agents (Python/TS), and a lightweight snippet-generator CLI (python + small Go helper) that produces validated sample requests for local smoke tests. Checklist: [x] tutorial text and stepper scaffolding; [x] typed tool-contract examples and minimal agent stubs; [x] snippet-generator CLI and unit tests; [x] docs site nav and sidebar integration; [x] CI smoke runs for generated snippets; [x] addressed reviewer feedback. Summary of changes and commits are below; highlights: added clear rate-limit and retry notes for hosted API usage, included explicit instruction how to wire snippet output into the local RAG playground, and kept the code samples intentionally minimal for copy-paste onboarding. CI had an intermittent e2e-smoke failure which was rerun and passed. Merge: squash-merged into main after approvals.
commits: init: add lightbook tutorial scaffold and stepper metadata
examples: add python and ts minimal agent stubs with typed tool contracts
cli: add snippet-generator (python) and small go formatter helper
docs: wire nav, add screenshots and short GIFs, update contributing guide
fix: doclink paths and test flakiness patch
review_comments: Jordan Kim: Overall this is great; please add a compact example showing rate-limited calls and a suggested retry/backoff snippet.
Maya Patel: Added a short 'rate-limits' section with sample backoff strategy and inline snippet; PTAL.
Luis Ortega: Suggested renaming the folder 'lightbook' to 'playbook-light' for consistency across docs; opted to keep 'lightbook' for now and added a migration note in README.
Hannah Zhao: Noted docs-build caching in CI could be optimized; approved after CI green and small wording tweaks.
release_notes: Adds an onboarding 'Lightbook' stepper tutorial for RAG authoring, two minimal agent examples (Python/TS), and a snippet-generator CLI to produce runnable doc samples. Improves docs nav and provides guidance for rate-limiting and retries. No breaking changes.
short_summary: Compact tutorial + CLI to extract validated API snippets and minimal RAG agent examples to speed onboarding and reproducible smoke tests
